newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary wants to buy back bank from GE -paper.
newsitem.headline: Hungary wants to buy back bank from GE -paper.

text.p: Hungary's Finance Ministry is conducting intensive negotiations with U.S.'s General Electric Capital Services over the repurchase of Budapest Bank's (BB) loss-making Polgari Bank unit, press reports said on Wednesday.
The Finance Ministry, GE Capital Services and Budapest Bank all declined to comment on the reports.

GE Capital Services, which has operational control of the bank, bought a 27.4 percent stake in BB last December. The EBRD, which is a financial investor, has 32.4 percent, the Hungarian state 22.8 percent and other investors 17.4 percent.
GE and the EBRD bought the combined stake for $87 million, after the state consolidated Budapest Bank with a 12 billion forints capital injection.

Hungarian business daily Vilaggazdasag said that the privatisation contract included a state guarantee of 8.25 billion forints and the Finance Ministry -- which acts as owner of the banks in privatisation deals -- might repurchase Polgari Bank, which is in need of a capital injection.
